subject.title: fix(doctor): follow symlinked launcher when locating sandbox setup scripts

question: When doctor runs from checkout B through an OpenClaw launcher linked to checkout A and both contain the setup script, should A’s launcher root or B’s current working directory win?
rationale: Current doctor is cwd-first, while the canonical shared resolver deliberately prefers the running launcher’s package root; either policy is technically coherent, but changing which executable script doctor runs requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept launcher-first
options.body: Use the running OpenClaw installation as the authoritative script root, retain the current patch, and add an explicit two-checkout ordering test.

options.title: Preserve cwd-first
options.body: Search a recognized cwd root first and use the shared symlink-aware roots only as fallback, preserving current doctor behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept launcher-first
recommendation.body: Use the running OpenClaw installation as the authoritative script root, retain the current patch, and add an explicit two-checkout ordering test.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the sandbox repair behavior and current doctor module, making him the strongest history-backed owner for deciding which checkout doctor should operate on.
